name: card
title: Card
description: Composable card parts for grouped content.

meta.customization: Customize each part through mason-card classes and data-part values for root, header, title, description, content, and footer.

parity.baseUi: Base UI has no first-class Card primitive, so parity is Mason component anatomy: root, header, title, description, content, and footer parts with stable data-part hooks. Gaps: sectioning role guidance, interactive card patterns, media slots, and density variants remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Kobalte has no direct Card primitive; this remains a styled composition component. Gaps: Solid polymorphic part rendering, heading-level guidance, and shared layout token metadata remain follow-up work.
